scripts.deploy: node scripts/setup.mjs && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy:local: node scripts/fetch-web.mjs && node scripts/setup.mjs -c wrangler.local.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.local.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.local.jsonc

CLIP_INDEX.description: Photo embeddings for smart search (SigLIP2). Set **Dimensions** to `768` and **Metric** to `cosine`.

FACE_INDEX.description: Face embeddings (buffalo_l). Set **Dimensions** to `512` and **Metric** to `cosine`.

APP_NAME.description: Product name used in password-reset email. `Immich` is fine.

MAIL_FROM.description: Sender of password-reset email, e.g. `Photos <photos@example.com>`. Email only goes out once you also add a [Resend](https://resend.com) API key as the `RESEND_API_KEY` secret; leave as is to skip.
